explanation: The operation was activated when the coup broke out. The task force was ordered out on 31 March and the Forrestal left Norfolk on 1 April; when Castelo Branco told Lincoln Gordon that logistical support would not be needed the order to disband came, at 17:22 on the 2nd. Read in this direction the edge says only what the record supports — the American movement followed the Brazilian one and was called off by it. What the Americans were answering, and why, is the disputed link into this same event.
